title: Debian Fan Club!
description: Debian Fan Club is an SMP focused on user experience and worldgen. We're focused on what the players want, not the admins. And we have just enough worldgen datapacks to make the worldgen feel fresh, as well.
body:
![The Debian logo on top of a Diorite block with text on the right side saying "Debian Fan Club!"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc501e06868429ed20f7bd2790da927d3769e641.png)

## Debian Fan Club is an SMP focused on user experience and worldgen.
We're focused on **what the players want, not the admins.**
If you want something, then suggest it! We'll poll our Discord and Stoat community!


We have **more than enough worldgen datapacks to make the worldgen feel fresh,** as well. This includes datapacks such as [Geophilic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/geophilic), [Hearths](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hearths), [Structory](https://modrinth.com/datapack/structory), [DnT](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dungeons-and-taverns) and some others.
_Not related to the focus of the server, but we do have [Chestpack Backpacks!](https://modrinth.com/datapack/chestpack-backpacks)_

We also have [RTP](https://modrinth.com/plugin/wildrtp), [TPA](https://modrinth.com/plugin/essentialsx), [GreifPrevention](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/griefprevention.1884/), [PvP Toggle](https://modrinth.com/plugin/pvp-toggle) and other plugins installed!
##
_This is self hosted on a laptop in my room. So just wait until the day I'm employed._
_But it does run well!_
_And the weird domain is because of playit!_
_The CURRENT player limit is 8 due to the server not being able to have player amounts tested, but it will go up once we get a better gauge of how stable it is at higher player counts!_
_World resets whenever we're out of storage!_
Stoat (bridged): https://stt.gg/fGpn5HBQ
##
### Server rules (also included in the Stoat and Discord servers)

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
1. Don't grief something unless the owner is fine with it.
This includes stealing items. little acts of grief like putting a block on a building really doesn't matter

2. Don't spawn camp.
Killing people at their spawn point over and over, or camping spawn to kill people

3. No exploiting/hacking
Includes x-raying

4. Trade properly
Don't trick a player into dropping their items for you without you giving what was agreed on in return.

5. No offensive symbols being used in a good light, please.
Swastikas and all that.

6. Limit your farms!
Animal farms could make a game super laggy, please don't have a farm with a tonnn of animals to a point where performance is impacted.
(Also don't do anything that impacts performance negatively for every player as well)

7. Respect others land
If you're entering someones territory, don't treat it as if it isn't claimed. And don't claim troll.
Claim trolling is claiming near someone to block their claim expanding or claiming something that isn't yours without permission.

8. No gore/porn part 2
Fake gore in builds are fine, just don't go extremely detailed. Suggestive are fine in builds, just don't make NSFW builds

</details> The 9 rules are so scary, we had to hide them.
